notes.stride: m the root travels per loop cycle (the clip stays in place)
notes.root_end: m the root has moved by the end of the clip, MMD axes [x (her left), y (up), z]; -z is toward the viewer / her front
notes.hold: frames [a, b] that loop seamlessly while she holds the pose
notes.kind: ambient: on her own; reaction: answers the visitor; both; locomotion: moving about

idle.desc: Standing with her arms relaxed at her sides, breathing softly, shifting her weight and tilting her head.

look_around.desc: Looks curiously left and right on her toes, puts a finger to her chin, then has an idea.

stretch.desc: A big stretch with the fingers laced overhead, swaying each way on her toes, then a contented sigh.

yawn.desc: A big yawn behind her hand with one arm stretching up, then rubs her eye and smiles sleepily.

hair_tuck.desc: Tucks a lock of hair behind her ear, lets it slip through her fingers, and glances up shyly.

heel_rock.desc: Rocks up onto her toes and back on her heels with her hands clasped, humming.

kick_pebble.desc: Kicks an imaginary pebble with her hands behind her back, watches it roll away and nods.

hum_sway.desc: Sways from foot to foot humming a tune, hands behind her back, head tilting to the beat.

check_shoe.desc: Lifts a foot behind her to check her shoe, turns it this way and that, then taps her toe twice.

sneeze.desc: Hitching breaths, a cute sneeze into her hand, a head shake, then rubs her nose, embarrassed.

sit_rest.desc: Squats down hugging her knees, rocks and hums, gives a little wave from down there, and stands back up.

head_pat.desc: Being patted on the head: shoulders up, hands at her chest, a bashful wiggle and a happy lean into it.

poke_startle.desc: Startled by a poke: hops back with her hands up, pouts with fists on her hips, then forgives with a smile.

annoyed_stomp.desc: Fists on her hips, two little stomps, turns away in a huff, peeks back and sticks her tongue out.

twirl.desc: Twirls once round on her toes with her arms floating out, then finishes with a little curtsy.

jump_happy.desc: Two happy hops with her arms flung up, then little fists of joy, wiggling side to side.

shy_cover.desc: Embarrassed: hides her face in her hands, turns away, peeks through her fingers, hides again.

wave_hello.desc: Waves hello with her whole body, rising on her toe, the other hand at her chest.

wave_bye.desc: Waves goodbye with both arms overhead on her toes, then a last small wave by her chest.

welcome_back.desc: Welcome back! A bounce and a jump with both arms up, then palms together with a happy sway.

bow.desc: A polite bow with her hands folded, then comes up with a smile and a tilt of the head.

curtsy.desc: A graceful curtsy, skirt held out and one foot behind, then a second little bob.

point_left.desc: Points to her left: "look, over there!", a hand on her hip, glances back at the viewer and points again.

point_right.desc: Points to her right: "look, over there!", a hand on her hip, glances back at the viewer and points again.

clap_cheer.desc: Claps excitedly with bouncing knees, a little hop, and a last clap held by her cheek.

thumbs_up.desc: A confident thumbs up with a wink and a nod, then another with a little hop.

heart.desc: A finger heart at her chest with a wink and a toe pop, then a big heart over her head.

balance_wobble.desc: Loses her balance, arms flung out, wobbles side to side, steadies and wipes her brow. Phew!

dizzy.desc: Dizzy: her head goes round, she stumbles a step each way, shakes it off and laughs at herself.

mining_swing.desc: Swings an imaginary pickaxe three times, then admires the haul in her cupped hands.

idol_dance.desc: A 10 s idol dance at 120 bpm: step-touches, a point, three claps, a spin and a finger heart.

peace_wink.desc: A peace sign by her eye with a wink and a toe pop, then a double peace under her chin.

blow_kiss.desc: Touches her fingers to her lips, blows the viewer a kiss with a leg pop, then holds her blushing cheeks.

cat_paws.desc: Cat paws at her chin, "nyan~": beckons with one paw then the other, then one paw raised by her face.

bunny_ears.desc: Makes bunny ears with her fingers, flops them, and does two little bunny hops.

skirt_spin.desc: Holds her skirt out and spins twice round on her toes, then sways to a stop.

ballet_pirouette.desc: Ballet: arms through first and fifth on relevé, an arabesque, a pirouette, and a révérence.

smell_flower.desc: Notices a flower, bends to pick it, smells it with her eyes closed and offers it to the viewer.

hair_twirl.desc: Twirls a lock of hair round her finger while gazing off, then notices the viewer and smiles shyly.

daydream.desc: Daydreams with her cheeks in her hands, one foot kicked up and swinging behind her, then a dreamy sigh.

finger_twiddle.desc: Shyly taps her index fingers together, toes turned in, peeking up at the viewer.

hands_behind_sway.desc: Hands behind her back, sways from foot to foot, then leans in toward the viewer with a tilt: "ne?"

make_a_wish.desc: Puts her palms together and makes a wish with her eyes closed, then opens her hands to the sky.

self_hug.desc: Hugs herself happily, wiggling side to side on her toes.

wake_up.desc: Dozes off and jerks awake, rubs her eyes, stretches with a big yawn, pats her cheeks: "yosh!"

peek_afar.desc: Shades her eyes with a hand and peers far off on tiptoe, spots something and waves at it.

ganbare.desc: Cheers the viewer on: little fists up, "ganbare!", one fist high with a hop, then a wink.

catch_butterfly.desc: Watches a butterfly flit about, catches it in her hands on tiptoe, peeks in, and waves as it flies off.

ehehe.desc: Scratches her cheek with one finger, "ehehe~", an embarrassed giggle with her tongue out.

idol_poses.desc: A run of cute idol poses: a V by the eye, a big heart, cheek pokes, cat paws, pointing at you, arms up, a kiss.

long_dance.desc: A 28 s dance at 120 bpm: a sway intro, step-touch claps, skirt side steps, a twirl, cat-paw hops, a point and a heart, arms waving overhead, a spin, and a curtsy.

walk.desc: A light girlish walk in place, one cycle (two steps); frame 0 = right foot planted under her, left foot passing.

run.desc: A girlish run in place, one cycle (two steps), forearms pumping.

skip.desc: A happy skip in place (step-hop on each foot), arms swinging high.

tiptoe.desc: Sneaking on tiptoe in place, paws up, peering left and right.

walk_start.desc: From the stance into the walk: ends on walk frame 0 (the root should start moving over these frames).

walk_stop.desc: From walk frame 0 back to the stance (the root should come to rest over these frames).

climb_up.desc: Climbs onto a block 0.5 m high whose front is 0.35 m ahead: hands on top, a knee up, pushes up and stands on it with a little "yatta". The root moves by root_end.

jump_down.desc: Standing on a 0.5 m ledge, hops down forward, lands soft in a crouch and pops up with a "ta-da". The root moves by root_end.

hide_crouch.desc: Crouches down small, hugging her knees as if hiding behind something, trembling a little; frames hold[0]..hold[1] loop seamlessly while she stays hidden.

peek_left.desc: Crouches, leans out to her left to peek around something, ducks back and stands up.

peek_right.desc: Crouches, leans out to her right to peek around something, ducks back and stands up.

fall_land.desc: Lands from a fall (frame 0 is just before touchdown, legs tucked, arms up): a deep squat, a wobble, stands up and dusts off her skirt.

look_up_reach.desc: Reaches up on tiptoe for something just out of reach, stretches, tries a little hop, then pouts.
